Verified 2026-10-11. Publisher: central-bank.

**Documented market:** BOK-Wire+ RTGS participant reporting; interbank accounts and limits, not commercial customer statement service.

## Scope and source notes

BOK-Wire+ ISO 20022 launched in May 2026. Three official scenario XML members demonstrate participant balance/limit reports and aggregate account reconciliation, with no Ntry or TxDtls. Each source member contains two roots, AppHdr and Document: the full member and unchanged contiguous Document payload are separately hash-pinned. This establishes interbank RTGS reporting, not a South Korean national corporate CAMT profile or commercial-bank service. Samples remain external-only because they were not established as designated public datasets eligible for unrestricted reuse.

[Publisher usage terms](https://www.bok.or.kr/portal/main/contents.do?menuNo=200228).
